# Calcul du seuil d'autocorrélation :

Moyenne de la durée (3s entre chaque pt) necessaire pour non réplication PAR METRIQUE

On considèrera qu'à **lag n**, si `acf(lag n) < 0.2`, les points sont **suffisamment indépendants** pour l'échantillonnage :

Rq : Les petits tracks ne peuvent pas être pseudorépliqués entre eux, car la balise passe en BF donc forcément 5min d'écart

```{r}
#| label: Séléction des tracks > 1h
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)

# Liste des HF.ID à garder
hf_to_keep <- TRACKS_HF_2026_ALL %>%
  filter(TS >= 5) %>% # A 5min
  pull(HF.ID) %>%
  unique()

# Filtrer DATA_HF
DATA_HF_filtered <- DATA_HF %>%
  filter(HF.ID %in% hf_to_keep)


# Diagnostic
DATA_HF_filtered %>%
  group_by(HF.ID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_points = n(),
    n_valid_height = sum(!is.na(height.above.ground_GPS)),
    pct_valid = n_valid_height / n_points * 100
  ) %>%
  summary()

```

## ground.speed

```{r}
# ================================
# AUTOCORRELATION POUR TOUS LES TRACKS
# ================================

acf_results <- DATA_HF_filtered %>%
  group_by(HF.ID) %>%
  summarise(
    acf_lag1 = {
      # On enlève les NA
      x <- na.omit(ground.speed)
      
      # On vérifie qu'il y a assez de points
      if(length(x) > 2) {
        # On calcule l'autocorrélation lag 1
        acf(x, plot = FALSE)$acf[2]
      } else {
        NA
      }
    }
  )

# → Résultat : une valeur par track
# → permet de voir si la pseudoréplication est générale
summary(acf_results) # En moyenne la pseudoreplication au sein des tracks est de 0.81403 pour la vitesse

# ================================
# TROUVER LE TEMPS D'INDEPENDANCE POUR TOUS LES TRACKS
# ================================

lag_results <- DATA_HF_filtered %>%
  group_by(HF.ID) %>%
  summarise(
    lag_indep = {
      x <- na.omit(ground.speed)
      acf_vals <- acf(x, plot = FALSE)$acf
      
      # Protection anti-aberrant + seuil 0.2
      lag_threshold <- min(length(x)*0.1, 100)
      first_lag <- which(acf_vals < 0.2)[1]
      min(first_lag, lag_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  )

summary(lag_results)

# → Résultat : combien de points pour devenir indépendant (par track)
lag_results
summary(lag_results) # vitesse (6 points median 7.5 points en moyenne)

# Moyenne de lag_indep de tous les tracks
lag_indep_mean <- mean (lag_results$lag_indep, na.rm = TRUE)
lag_indep_mean

# ================================
# PASSER DES POINTS AU TEMPS
# ================================

# Pas de temps moyen pour un track : 3 secondes

# Temps d'indépendance (en secondes)
time_indep_mean_speed <- (lag_indep_mean * 3)/60
time_indep_mean_speed

# ================================
# CHOISIR UNE TAILLE DE SEGMENT : Avec cette méthode ce sont les plus petits segments possibles ET indépendants les uns des autres qui sont choisis.
# ================================

# Règle : segment = 3 fois le temps d'indépendance

time_segment_speed <- (time_indep_mean_speed * 3)
time_segment_speed 


###
lag_results_corrected <- DATA_HF_filtered %>%
  group_by(HF.ID) %>%
  summarise(
    lag_indep = {
      x <- na.omit(ground.speed)
      if (length(x) > 2) {
        lag_threshold <- min(length(x) * 0.1, 100)
        acf_vals <- acf(x, plot = FALSE, lag.max = ceiling(lag_threshold))$acf
        first_lag <- which(acf_vals < 0.2)[1]
        min(first_lag, lag_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA
      }
    }
  )

mean(lag_results_corrected$lag_indep, na.rm = TRUE)
(mean(lag_results_corrected$lag_indep, na.rm = TRUE) * 3) / 60  # en minutes

```

Représentation

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)

# ================================
# RECALCUL CORRIGÉ (lag.max étendu)
# ================================
lag_results_corrected <- DATA_HF_filtered %>%
  group_by(HF.ID) %>%
  summarise(
    lag_indep = {
      x <- na.omit(ground.speed)
      if (length(x) > 2) {
        lag_threshold <- min(length(x) * 0.1, 100)
        acf_vals <- acf(x, plot = FALSE, lag.max = ceiling(lag_threshold))$acf
        first_lag <- which(acf_vals < 0.2)[1]
        min(first_lag, lag_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA
      }
    }
  )

lag_indep_mean_corrected <- mean(lag_results_corrected$lag_indep, na.rm = TRUE)
time_indep_mean_corrected <- (lag_indep_mean_corrected * 3) / 60

# ================================
# PANEL A : exemple de courbe ACF (version rapide)
# ================================

# Stats par track calculées une seule fois (rapide, vectorisé)
track_stats <- DATA_HF_filtered %>%
  group_by(HF.ID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_valid = sum(!is.na(ground.speed)),
    sd_valid = sd(ground.speed, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Jointure au lieu de rowwise
valid_tracks <- lag_results_corrected %>%
  filter(!is.na(lag_indep)) %>%
  left_join(track_stats, by = "HF.ID") %>%
  filter(n_valid > 30, sd_valid > 0.1)

example_id <- valid_tracks$HF.ID[which.min(abs(valid_tracks$lag_indep - median(valid_tracks$lag_indep, na.rm = TRUE)))]

x_example <- DATA_HF_filtered %>%
  filter(HF.ID == example_id) %>%
  pull(ground.speed) %>%
  na.omit()

length(x_example)
sd(x_example, na.rm = TRUE)

# ================================
acf_vals_ex <- acf(x_example, plot = FALSE, lag.max = 30)$acf
acf_df <- data.frame(lag = 0:(length(acf_vals_ex) - 1), acf = as.numeric(acf_vals_ex))
lag_indep_example <- which(acf_df$acf < 0.2)[1] - 1

p_acf <- ggplot(acf_df, aes(x = lag, y = acf)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.2, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = lag, xend = lag, y = 0, yend = acf), color = "dodgerblue4", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(color = "dodgerblue4", size = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = lag_indep_example, linetype = "dotted", color = "navyblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = lag_indep_example + 1, y = 0.85,
           label = paste0("Independence lag = ", lag_indep_example, " pts"),
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5, color = "navyblue") +
  labs(
    title = "(A)",
    x = "Lag (points, 3-sec resolution)",
    y = "Autocorrelation (ACF)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))

p_acf

# ================================
# PANEL B : distribution corrigée (plus de pic artificiel à 100)
# ================================
p_lagdist <- ggplot(lag_results_corrected, aes(x = lag_indep)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "dodgerblue4", color = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = lag_indep_mean_corrected, color = "navyblue", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = lag_indep_mean_corrected + 1, y = Inf,
           label = paste0("Mean = ", round(lag_indep_mean_corrected, 1), " pts (", 
                           round(time_indep_mean_corrected, 2), " min)"),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 2, size = 3.5, color = "navyblue") +
  labs(
    title = "(B)",
    x = "Lag at ACF < 0.2 (points)",
    y = "Number of tracks"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
p_lagdist

# Combien de tracks plafonnent vraiment à 100 ?
n_capped <- sum(lag_results_corrected$lag_indep == 100, na.rm = TRUE)
n_total <- sum(!is.na(lag_results_corrected$lag_indep))
n_capped
n_total



# ================================
# COMBINER + note en légende
# ================================
final_plot <- p_acf + p_lagdist +
  plot_annotation(
    subtitle = "Segments cut at the independence lag (ACF < 0.2)",
    caption = paste0(
      "Segments used in analyses: 1.51 min. Refined estimate shown here: ",
      round(time_indep_mean_corrected, 2), " min (~11% difference due to ACF lag-range truncation in the original computation)."
    ),
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8.5, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey40", face = "italic")
    )
  )

final_plot

ggsave(
  filename = here("Figures/ANNEXES/acf_segment_methodology.png"),
  plot = final_plot,
  width = 10, height = 4.7, dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
# Calcule le temps d'indépendance pour chaque track (hauteur)
lag_results <- DATA_HF_filtered %>%
  group_by(HF.ID) %>%
  summarise(
    lag_indep = {
      # Extrait la série hauteur du track et supprime les NA
      x <- na.omit(height.above.ground_GPS)
      # Calcule la fonction d'autocorrélation complète (sans graphique)
      acf_vals <- acf(x, plot = FALSE)$acf
      
      # Plafond protecteur : max 10% de la série ou 100 lags
      lag_threshold <- min(length(x)*0.1, 100)
      # Trouve le 1er lag où corrélation < seuil 0.2
      first_lag <- which(acf_vals < 0.2)[1]
      # Retourne le minimum (protection anti-lag aberrant)
      min(first_lag, lag_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  )

summary(lag_results)  # Beaucoup moins de NA
```

# Création des jeux de données sub


## En prenant 1 point par intervalle (sans découpe)

### data_sub_speed

#### Subsampling

```{r}
# time_indep_mean_speed # = (pour la vitesse)  [1]  1.494527 min
attach(data_HF)

# Script Lucile MORCELET 10/04/2026
# Subsampling GPS tracking at the individual level

# data$timestamp must be formatted as POSIXct object
# data$Individual_ID is a character or factor.

# Extracting timestamps
timestamp_num_min <- as.numeric(data_HF$timestamp) / 60

# Delimitation of the subsampling interval : definition of the parameters ----
  dtime.aim <- time_indep_mean_speed # expected sub-sampling frequency (mins)
  tolerance <- 30/60 # tolerance of 30s (indicated in mins)
  # positions > (dtime.aim - tolerance) can be selected only if no other localisation are closer to dtime.aim  

  dindex_max <- tolerance * 60 * 2 # assuming minimum time difference of 1 second 
  sub.index <- NULL # vector to store subsampled localisation index
  
# Subsampling dataset at the level of each individuals -----  
for(p in unique(data_HF$individual.local.identifier)) {
  
  
  index_tag <- which(data_HF$individual.local.identifier == p) # Vector of index for each localisation
  sub.index[length(sub.index) + 1] <- index_tag[1] # Always start with the first localisation 
  
  if(length(index_tag) > 1){
    
    # Check if time lag between k and last selected localisation is within the sub-sampling frequency (i.e., dtime.aim +/- tolerance)
    for(k in 2:length(index_tag)){
      # Check if selected localisation is posterior in time
      if(index_tag[k] > sub.index[length(sub.index)]){
        
        # If both localisation are enough distant in time:
        if(timestamp_num_min[index_tag[k]] -
           timestamp_num_min[sub.index[length(sub.index)]] > (dtime.aim - tolerance)){
          
          # 1) and k is the last localisation : k localisation is selected
          if(k == length(index_tag)){
            sub.index[length(sub.index) + 1] <- index_tag[k]
            
            # 2) and next localisation after k is enough distant in time : k localisation is selected   
          } else if((timestamp_num_min[index_tag[k] + 1] -
                     timestamp_num_min[sub.index[length(sub.index)]]) > (dtime.aim + tolerance)) {
            sub.index[length(sub.index) + 1] <- index_tag[k]
            
            # 3) else look for the next localisation that respect dtime.aim
          } else {
            # index_max either based on dtime.aim + tolerance, or last position of tag
            index_max <- ifelse((k + dindex_max) < length(index_tag), (k + dindex_max), length(index_tag))
            
            # Calculate timelag between last selected position and non-subsampled positions and compare it the targeted interval
            diffs.to.aim <- abs((timestamp_num_min[index_tag[k]:index_tag[index_max]] -
                                   timestamp_num_min[sub.index[length(sub.index)]]) - dtime.aim)
            # Selection of the closer localisation to dtime.aim (not necessarily k)
            index_next <- which(diffs.to.aim == min(diffs.to.aim))[1]
            sub.index[length(sub.index) + 1] <- (index_tag[k:index_max])[index_next]
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
} 
  
# Check if duplicates are present
  if(anyDuplicated(sub.index) > 0){
    print("Issue: Subsampling produced duplicates.")
    data_sub_speed <- data_HF[sub.index,]
    
    print(nrow(data_sub_speed%>%
                 dplyr::group_by(individual.local.identifier, timestamp)%>%
                 summarise(n = n()) %>%
                 filter(n>1)%>%
                 dplyr::ungroup()))
    
    data_sub_speed<- data_sub_speed%>%
      # Retrait des positions dupliquées (date et heure) par individu:
      dplyr::group_by(individual.local.identifier)%>%
      dplyr::distinct(timestamp, .keep_all = T) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()
    
    }else{
  data_sub_speed <- data_HF[sub.index,]
  }
```

### data_sub_height

#### Subsampling

```{r}
time_indep_mean_height #  2.880817 min
attach(data_HF)

# Script Lucile MORCELET 10/04/2026
# Subsampling GPS tracking at the individual level

# data$timestamp must be formatted as POSIXct object
# data$Individual_ID is a character or factor.

# Extracting timestamps
timestamp_num_min <- as.numeric(data_HF$timestamp) / 60

# Delimitation of the subsampling interval : definition of the parameters ----
  dtime.aim <- time_indep_mean_height # expected sub-sampling frequency (mins)
  tolerance <- 30/60 # tolerance of 30s (indicated in mins)
  # positions > (dtime.aim - tolerance) can be selected only if no other localisation are closer to dtime.aim  

  dindex_max <- tolerance * 60 * 2 # assuming minimum time difference of 1 second 
  sub.index <- NULL # vector to store subsampled localisation index

  

# Subsampling dataset at the level of each individuals -----  
for(p in unique(data_HF$individual.local.identifier)) {
  
  
  index_tag <- which(data_HF$individual.local.identifier == p) # Vector of index for each localisation
  sub.index[length(sub.index) + 1] <- index_tag[1] # Always start with the first localisation 
  
  if(length(index_tag) > 1){
    
    # Check if time lag between k and last selected localisation is within the sub-sampling frequency (i.e., dtime.aim +/- tolerance)
    for(k in 2:length(index_tag)){
      # Check if selected localisation is posterior in time
      if(index_tag[k] > sub.index[length(sub.index)]){
        
        # If both localisation are enough distant in time:
        if(timestamp_num_min[index_tag[k]] -
           timestamp_num_min[sub.index[length(sub.index)]] > (dtime.aim - tolerance)){
          
          # 1) and k is the last localisation : k localisation is selected
          if(k == length(index_tag)){
            sub.index[length(sub.index) + 1] <- index_tag[k]
            
            # 2) and next localisation after k is enough distant in time : k localisation is selected   
          } else if((timestamp_num_min[index_tag[k] + 1] -
                     timestamp_num_min[sub.index[length(sub.index)]]) > (dtime.aim + tolerance)) {
            sub.index[length(sub.index) + 1] <- index_tag[k]
            
            # 3) else look for the next localisation that respect dtime.aim
          } else {
            # index_max either based on dtime.aim + tolerance, or last position of tag
            index_max <- ifelse((k + dindex_max) < length(index_tag), (k + dindex_max), length(index_tag))
            
            # Calculate timelag between last selected position and non-subsampled positions and compare it the targeted interval
            diffs.to.aim <- abs((timestamp_num_min[index_tag[k]:index_tag[index_max]] -
                                   timestamp_num_min[sub.index[length(sub.index)]]) - dtime.aim)
            # Selection of the closer localisation to dtime.aim (not necessarily k)
            index_next <- which(diffs.to.aim == min(diffs.to.aim))[1]
            sub.index[length(sub.index) + 1] <- (index_tag[k:index_max])[index_next]
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}  
  
# Check if duplicates are present
  if(anyDuplicated(sub.index) > 0){
    print("Issue: Subsampling produced duplicates.")
    data_sub_speed <- data_HF[sub.index,]
    
    print(nrow(data_sub_height%>%
                 dplyr::group_by(individual.local.identifier, timestamp)%>%
                 summarise(n = n()) %>%
                 filter(n>1)%>%
                 dplyr::ungroup()))
    
    data_sub_height<- data_sub_height%>%
      # Retrait des positions dupliquées (date et heure) par individu:
      dplyr::group_by(individual.local.identifier)%>%
      dplyr::distinct(timestamp, .keep_all = T) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()
    
    }else{
  data_sub_height <- data_HF[sub.index,]
  }
  
```

## Test point par point

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: false
# Prendre les tracks de 30min, calculer extrapolation de 1min, 10min etc et voir a quel moment c'est plausible, a partir de quelle durée c'est extrapolable.


# 1. Sélection des tracks 30 min : seul HF.ID = 64
hf_to_keep <- TRACKS_HF_2026_ALL %>%
  filter(TS >= 29 & TS <= 30) %>%
  pull(HF.ID) %>%
  unique()
hf_to_keep

DATA_HF_filtered <- data_HF %>%
  filter(HF.ID %in% hf_to_keep)

# 2. Référence : gain total sur 30 min
alt_gain_30min <- DATA_HF_filtered %>%
  group_by(HF.ID) %>%
  summarise(
    alt_gain_30min = sum(alt_gain, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
alt_gain_30min

# 3. Création des minutes (time-based, pas index-based)
minute_gain <- DATA_HF_filtered %>%
  group_by(HF.ID) %>%
  arrange(timestamp) %>%
  mutate(
    t0 = first(timestamp),
    minute = floor(as.numeric(difftime(timestamp, t0, units = "mins")))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(HF.ID, minute) %>%
  summarise(
    alt_gain_min = sum(alt_gain, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_points = sum(!is.na(alt_gain)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 4. Filtrage simple (optionnel mais recommandé)
minute_gain <- minute_gain %>%
  filter(n_points > 5)

# 5. Extrapolation à 30 min
comparison <- minute_gain %>%
  mutate(alt_gain_extrapolated = alt_gain_min * 30) %>%
  left_join(alt_gain_30min, by = "HF.ID") %>%
  mutate(
    ratio = alt_gain_extrapolated / alt_gain_30min,
    error = alt_gain_extrapolated - alt_gain_30min
  )
comparison




#################### Version comparaison avec 2min 5min et 10min

# Durées à tester
durations <- c(1, 2,3,4, 5, 10,20)

# Fonction pour une durée donnée
compute_extrapolation <- function(d) {
  
  DATA_HF_filtered %>%
    group_by(HF.ID) %>%
    arrange(timestamp) %>%
    mutate(
      t0 = first(timestamp),
      time_min = as.numeric(difftime(timestamp, t0, units = "mins")),
      window = floor(time_min / d)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    
    group_by(HF.ID, window) %>%
    summarise(
      alt_gain_window = sum(alt_gain, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_points = sum(!is.na(alt_gain)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    
    filter(n_points > 5) %>%
    
    mutate(
      duration = d,
      alt_gain_extrapolated = alt_gain_window * (30 / d)
    ) %>%
    
    left_join(alt_gain_30min, by = "HF.ID") %>%
    
    mutate(
      ratio = alt_gain_extrapolated / alt_gain_30min,
      error = alt_gain_extrapolated - alt_gain_30min
    )
}

# Appliquer à toutes les durées
comparison_all <- map_dfr(durations, compute_extrapolation)
comparison_all

# Créer l'erreur en %
comparison_all <- comparison_all %>%
  mutate(
    error_pct = (error / alt_gain_30min) * 100
  )
# résumé par durée
summary_by_duration <- comparison_all %>%
  group_by(duration) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_error_pct = mean(abs(error_pct), na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_error_pct = sd(error_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ratio = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )
summary_by_duration # => Ca reste des erreurs très grande, on gardera seulement les tracks supérieurs à 5minutes.
```

```{r}
# ===============================================================================================

# Créer les segment_globals à partir du temps
# Etape 1
max_TS <- 30 # 30 minutes

data_HF$segment <- NA

for(id in unique(data_HF$HF.ID)){
  
  index <- which(data_HF$HF.ID == id)
  
  cum_time <- cumsum(data_HF$dtime_orig[index])
  
  data_HF$segment[index] <- floor(cum_time / max_TS)
}

# Etape 2

str(data_HF)

segment_global <- seq_along(segments_unique)

# créer une nouvelle colonne segment_global
data_HF$segment_global <- match(data_HF$HF_ID_seg, segments_unique)

length(unique(data_HF$segment_global)) # doit être égal au nombre total de segments découpés

ov_HF_tracks$first_lon <- data_HF$location.lon[ID_switch]
ov_HF_tracks$last_lat <- data_HF$location.lat[c(ID_switch[-1]-1, nrow(data_HF))]
ov_HF_tracks$last_lon <- data_HF$location.lon[c(ID_switch[-1]-1, nrow(data_HF))]

ID <- "1"
index <- which(data_HF$segment_global == ID)
plot(data_HF$location.lat[index] ~ data_HF$location.long[index], type = "l", xlab = "Longitude", ylab = "Latitude",
     main = ID)
index <- which(ov_HF_tracks$segment_global == ID)
lines(c(ov_HF_tracks$first_lon[index], ov_HF_tracks$last_lon[index]),
      c(ov_HF_tracks$first_lat[index], ov_HF_tracks$last_lat[index]), col = "red")

# Distance between first and last fix

longlat_first <- cbind(ov_HF_tracks$first_lon, ov_HF_tracks$first_lat)
coord_first <- SpatialPoints(longlat_first, proj4string=CRS("EPSG:4326"))
longlat_last <- cbind(ov_HF_tracks$last_lon, ov_HF_tracks$last_lat)
coord_last <- SpatialPoints(longlat_last, proj4string=CRS("EPSG:4326"))

ov_HF_tracks$dist_first_last <- NA
ov_HF_tracks$dist_first_last <- distGeo(p1 = coord_first, p2 = coord_last)/1000 # in km
summary(ov_HF_tracks$dist_first_last) # Max. 135


# Cumulative distance ####
# Sum of segment_global distances

# Re-calculate 2D delta distance for subsampled data (meters)
longlat <- cbind(data_HF$location.long[2:nrow(data_HF)], data_HF$location.lat[2:nrow(data_HF)])
coord <- SpatialPoints(longlat, proj4string=CRS("EPSG:4326"))
longlat_min1 <- cbind(data_HF$location.long[1:(nrow(data_HF)-1)], data_HF$location.lat[1:(nrow(data_HF)-1)])
coord_min1 <- SpatialPoints(longlat_min1, proj4string=CRS("EPSG:4326"))

data_HF$ddist_2D <- c(NA, distGeo(p1 = coord, p2 = coord_min1)) # in m
index_ID.switch <- which(data_HF$segment_global[2:nrow(data_HF)] != data_HF$segment_global[1:(nrow(data_HF)-1)]) + 1
if(length(index_ID.switch) != 0){data_HF$ddist_2D[index_ID.switch] <- NA}
hist(data_HF$ddist_2D)
summary(data_HF$ddist_2D)

cum_dist_tab <- tapply(data_HF$ddist_2D, factor(data_HF$segment_global), sum, na.rm = T) / 1000 # In km
cum_dist_tab <- data.frame(segment_global = names(cum_dist_tab), cum_dist = cum_dist_tab)
ov_HF_tracks <- merge(ov_HF_tracks, cum_dist_tab, "segment_global", all.x = T)
summary(ov_HF_tracks$cum_dist) # Max. 185 km
hist(ov_HF_tracks$cum_dist)

plot(ov_HF_tracks$cum_dist ~ ov_HF_tracks$dist_first_last)
abline(0,1)

rm(longlat, coord, longlat_min1, coord_min1,
   index_ID.switch, cum_dist_tab, index_ID.switch)


# Add country names ####

ov_HF_tracks$countries <- NA
start.time <- Sys.time()
for(i in 1:nrow(ov_HF_tracks)){
  index <- which(data_HF$segment_global == ov_HF_tracks$segment_global[i])
  ov_HF_tracks$countries[i] <- paste(unique(data_HF$country[index]), collapse = ", ")
}
delta.time <- Sys.time() - start.time; delta.time # 20 s
summary(factor(ov_HF_tracks$countries))

rm(start.time, delta.time, i, index)


# Add latitudinal/longitudinal difference ####
# Based on first and last coordinates

ov_HF_tracks$lat_diff <- ov_HF_tracks$last_lat - ov_HF_tracks$first_lat
hist(ov_HF_tracks$lat_diff)
summary(ov_HF_tracks$lat_diff)
```

```{r}
# Tracks ALT
load(here("Alice/STE_data_preparation_June_2026/2.Data_preparation/2.5_OUTPUT_STE_France_HF_track_table_ALT_2026-11-08.RData"))

# Extrapolation

  mutate(
    alt_gain_30min = alt_gain * (30 / TS)
  )
plot(alt_gain_30min~TS, data=OV_HF_tracks_ALT)

library(ggplot2)
library(hexbin)

extrap_alt_gain <- ggplot(OV_HF_tracks_ALT,
       aes(x = TS, y = alt_gain_30min)) +
  geom_hex(bins = 40) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Number\nof segments") +

  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

ggsave(
  filename = here("Figures/ANNEXES/extrap_alt_gain.png"),
```

# Proportion de HF par ID

```{r}
# Tous les points HF et BF : 1 ligne = 1 point
load(here("Alice/STE_data_preparation_June_2026/2.Data_preparation/2.1_OUTPUT_STE_France_processed_all_A_2026-11-08.RData"))
# data

library(dplyr)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::lag)

res <- data %>%
  arrange(individual.local.identifier, timestamp) %>%
  group_by(individual.local.identifier) %>%
  mutate(
    dt = as.numeric(difftime(timestamp, lag(timestamp), units = "secs")),
    hf = ifelse(dt == 3, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    prop_HF = mean(hf, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )
res

library(flextable)
library(officer)

# Mise en forme du tableau
ft <- flextable(res)
ft <- set_header_labels(ft,
  individual.local.identifier = "Individual ID",
  prop_HF = "Proportion HF",
  n = "N points"
)
ft <- colformat_double(ft, j = "prop_HF", digits = 3)
ft <- autofit(ft)
ft <- theme_vanilla(ft)  # ou theme_box(), selon ton style habituel

# Création du document Word et insertion du tableau
doc <- read_docx()
doc <- body_add_par(doc, "Proportion of high-frequency (HF) GPS points per individual", style = "heading 1")
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, value = ft)

#print(doc, target = "C:/Users/alrodrigues/Documents/M2 AMU/STAGE M2/Figures/table_prop_HF_per_individual.docx")
```
